ITEM 1 | Round orange carrot slices, bright orange with lighter center rings, glossy cooked surface, about 4 cm diameter each, roughly 1 cm thick, several pieces scattered on the left side of the plate | 60
ITEM 2 | Cooked brown rice grains, reddish-brown with a matte, slightly sticky surface, mounded in the center-left area, covering about one quarter of the plate | 150
ITEM 3 | Cooked grain, tan-golden and crumbly with small separate kernels, matte dry surface, spread in a mound at lower center of the plate, about 9 cm across | 110
ITEM 4 | Mixed sautéed vegetables, including dark green leafy pieces, orange shredded carrot strips, red bell pepper strips, and pale yellow-green squash rounds, glossy with light oil sheen, piled on the right half of the plate, about 12 cm across and 2 cm tall | 130
ITEM 5 | Whole dark purple-black olives, smooth wrinkled skin, glossy, about 2 cm long each, clustered in the lower right corner, roughly 12 pieces | 50
ITEM 6 | Thin yellow pepper strips, bright yellow, soft and glossy with slight moisture, a few pieces scattered among the carrots and rice on the left-lower area | 15
ITEM 7 | Pale yellow-green cooked vegetable chunks, soft, glossy, with a light oil sheen, one or two pieces near the left edge of the vegetable pile, about 3 cm each | 25
